ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $OC$ is the angle bisector of $\angle AOB$, $\angle AOD = 2\angle BOD$, and $\angle COD = 18^\circ$. Please find the measure of $\angle BOD$ in degrees.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the construction we get \\
Since $OC$ is the bisector of $\angle AOB$, \\
Therefore $\angle BOC=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOB$; \\
Since $\angle AOD=2\angle BOD$, \\
Therefore $\angle AOB=3\angle BOD$, i.e., $\angle BOD=\frac{1}{3}\angle AOB$; \\
Therefore $\angle COD=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOB-\frac{1}{3}\angle AOB=\frac{1}{6}\angle AOB$, \\
Therefore $\angle BOD=2\angle COD$, \\
Since $\angle COD=18^\circ$, \\
Therefore $\angle BOD=\boxed{36^\circ}$.
